translation.greeting: Hi, I'm Icaro, a full-stack developer.
translation.title: I turn ideas into digital products people enjoy using.
translation.description: I design and build web and mobile applications end to end, from frontend to backend. Fast, accessible products ready to grow with your business.
translation.portraitCaption: Web, mobile and backend, with the same care.
translation.servicesTitle: From the first sketch to deploy, I take care of the whole product.
translation.servicesDescription: Websites, systems, apps and automations built with the right technology for each challenge: TypeScript and Go, with React, Next.js, React Native, NestJS and Gin.
translation.serviceWebSummary: Company sites, landing pages and e-commerce that open doors.
translation.serviceWebBody: I build fast, accessible websites with React and Next.js (server rendering, static generation and SEO), designed to load in seconds and turn visits into leads.
translation.serviceMobileSummary: Android and iOS apps from a single codebase.
translation.serviceMobileBody: I build React Native apps that deliver the same experience on iOS and Android, with notifications, admin dashboards and integration with your product's APIs.
translation.workDescription: A few of the products I've designed and built for clients and partners.
translation.workCta: I want a project like this
translation.fillInTheForm: Tell me about your idea. I read every message and will get back to you to talk about your project.
translation.typeYourMessage: Tell me a bit about the project, timeline and goal.
translation.name: Name
translation.emailSentedSuccess: Message sent. I'll get back to you soon.

translation.serviceSystemsSummary: Web systems, customer portals and integrations.
translation.serviceSystemsBody: I structure organized, testable backends with NestJS and high-performance APIs in Go with Gin. I integrate with CRMs, payment providers, WhatsApp and the other APIs your business already uses.
translation.serviceSeoSummary: A strategy to be found by the people looking for you.
translation.serviceSeoBody: I take care of the technical foundation (performance, structured data, local SEO) so your site shows up in search and brings in leads consistently.
translation.serviceAutomationSummary: Fewer manual tasks, more clarity to decide.
translation.serviceAutomationBody: I build automations, dashboards and APIs that take repetitive work off your team and put the numbers that matter in front of you.
translation.principlePerformanceBody: Speed isn't a final tweak. It's decided in the architecture, before the first screen.
translation.principleIntegrationBody: What I build plugs into the systems you already use, without rework.
translation.principleClarityBody: Scope, deadlines and approvals in writing. You know what comes at every stage.
translation.principlePartnerBody: Launch is the beginning. I follow the results and plan the next improvements.
translation.processStep1Body: I get to know your business, your audience and what needs to change.
translation.processStep2Body: I define the solution, priorities, scope and deliverables.
translation.processStep3Body: Design and development, with your feedback along the way.
translation.processStep4Body: I ship, track the results and plan the next improvements.
translation.faq1Q: I already have a website. Can you improve it?
translation.faq1A: Yes. I start with an assessment and tell you whether it's worth improving the current site or rebuilding, and why.
translation.faq2A: First I understand the goal and the integrations you need. The proposal lists stages, timeline and investment. The first conversation is free of commitment.
translation.faq3Q: Do you work with clients outside your city?
translation.faq3A: Yes. I work remotely with clients across Brazil and abroad.
translation.faq4Q: Can it integrate with the tools I already use?
translation.faq4A: In most cases, yes: CRMs, payment providers, WhatsApp and APIs in general. I assess each integration at the start.
translation.faq5Q: Who owns the code at the end?
translation.faq5A: You do. The project, including the code and the accounts in scope, belongs to your company.
translation.faq6A: I offer support, maintenance and ongoing improvements, with the terms set in the proposal.
translation.whatsappMessage: Hi Icaro! I found your portfolio and would like to talk about a project.
